notes.title: Dandelion Void Wishlist Reveal
notes.content:
Dandelion Void is now available for Steam Wishlist.

This is a big milestone for us, one that's been about two years in the making. From a little side project, to a work of passion, the nature of Dandelion Void has evolved into something I'm already very proud of. There is much work to be done ahead, but the Steam Wishlist is a big step towards getting this game into everyone's hands.

Thank you so much for following along this far, and we look forward to showing off more cool features and progress in the coming months!

- Brian
